document_description: Read `.claude/commands/eap-deck-generate.md` for the full workflow. Identify the source directory from arguments or ask. Read `INSTRUCTIONS.md` or `README.md` in that directory for template and naming instructions. Run `python .utils/generators/pptx-generator/pptx-generator.py <source-dir> -o <output.pptx> -v`. Report the output file path and slide count.
